name: Shadow The Hedgehog (Ekko)
creator: sauronkaiser
description:
Base champion: Ekko

Skin:  Default

Author: Sauronkaiser

Description: Shadow from the Sonic franchise

Features:

-New model and textures.

-New full set of animations.

-New sounds.

-New particles

-New Splashart loading screen.

-New Ability icons and HUD.

-included voiceover.

-Ultimate edgy liveform.

-Guns and motorbike also included.

Sources:

-All animations made by me

-Rig and model extracted from sonic forces, then adapted.

-Voices from Sonic Boom.

-Fireweapons extracted from Counter Strike Source.

-Motorbike extracted from a Final Fantasy game

-The joke emote references the Ugandan Knuckles meme from VRchat

-The taunt emote references the Shadow face meme from the Archie comics.

-The Dance emote music is All Hail Shadow by Crush 40.

-The laugh emote references the Sanic meme. Also its music is Live and Learn by Crush 40.

-The recall music is All of Me by Crush 40.
